reasoning_content:
The emulator process is gone (either killed by the pkill before my shell died, or `adb emu kill` did it). Gradle daemon pid 7703 is still around (or a new one?). gradle.properties hasn't been changed (my shell died before the sed).

Let me kill the daemon by PID and apply the sed, then verify the emulator state.

action.command: kill 7703 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; sed -i 's/-Xmx8G -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=4G/-Xmx3G -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=1G/' /workspace/android/gradle.properties && cat /workspace/android/gradle.properties; /opt/android-sdk/platform-tools/adb devices; free -h | head -2
